definitions.meaning: To lead or bring in, introduce

quotations.old_english: Ingelédde ofer hie Drihten weter séwe
quotations.english: the Lord brought upon them the water of the sea

quotations.old_english: Óþ ðæt ic ðé ingelǽde on mínes Fæder hús
quotations.english: until I bring thee into my father's house

source_text: in-gelǽdan; p. de To lead or bring in, introduce :-- Ingelédde ofer hie Drihten weter séwe the Lord brought upon them the water of the sea, Cantic. Moys. 23; Thw. notæ, p. 30. Óþ ðæt ic ðé ingelǽde on mínes Fæder hús until I bring thee into my father's house, Blickl. Homl. 191, 19. Ingelǽded introducta, Bd. 4, 9; S. 576, 37.
in-gelǽdan. Add :-- Is ingelǽded inditur, Wrt. Voc. ii. 48, 61.
